hypotheses.claim: Collection kind is part of canonical executable semantics and must participate in semantic identity.
hypotheses.falsifier: Find a sound universal normalization in which SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED remain behaviorally equivalent across all registered operations without preserving kind.

hypotheses.claim: SET<T> should be order-insensitive and duplicate-idempotent in semantic canonicalization.
hypotheses.falsifier: A Clay operation declared SET changes meaning under permutation or duplicate insertion without an additional semantic annotation.

hypotheses.claim: ORDERED<T> must preserve sequence order and multiplicity as semantic data.
hypotheses.falsifier: An operation declared ORDERED can soundly erase order for all consumers and effects.

hypotheses.claim: MULTISET<T> should ignore order but preserve multiplicity.
hypotheses.falsifier: A multiset operation can soundly collapse duplicate counts or requires sequence order as part of meaning.

hypotheses.claim: WEIGHTED<T,W> requires explicit key/weight semantics; duplicate keys are invalid unless an aggregation policy is explicitly typed.
hypotheses.falsifier: A deterministic domain-independent duplicate-weight aggregation can be inferred without changing semantics or policy.

hypotheses.claim: A Unified ClayCode Query IR must carry result collection kind into physical lowering; backend-default bag/set/order behavior is insufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: A type-erased lowerer matches a typed reference over adversarial duplicate/order workloads across target engines.

hypotheses.claim: Critical projection receipts should bind semantic identity, exact contract/provenance instance identity and exact emitted view identity separately.
hypotheses.falsifier: A two-axis receipt detects all semantic/provenance/view mutations with no false equality/inequality while preserving replay needs.

hypotheses.claim: Collection casts require explicit loss classes rather than implicit coercion.
hypotheses.falsifier: Implicit casts can be proven semantics-preserving for the complete relevant source/target operation class.

hypotheses.claim: Semantic and contract hashes should be computed at commit time and referenced in cognition-hot paths; reader-view hashing remains per emitted view.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target Rust/C/Android runtime shows recomputation is cheaper or cached identities create unacceptable invalidation complexity.

hypotheses.claim: MOSAIC selection_plan_hash must change when a query rewrite changes collection cardinality/order/weight semantics even if record bytes are unchanged.
hypotheses.falsifier: Changed collection semantics never changes candidate membership/ranking/effect in matched target workloads.

hypotheses.claim: ClayGraph relation operands and Assembly candidate structures need declared collection/role semantics rather than universal set normalization.
hypotheses.falsifier: All current ClayGraph relation and Assembly structures are sound under one universal collection algebra.

hypotheses.claim: Typed collection semantics can serve as a shared canonical contract across heterogeneous UnifiedDB backends while retaining specialized physical execution.
hypotheses.falsifier: Cross-engine lowering cannot preserve the declared collection semantics or costs exceed specialized explicit APIs on target traces.
